reviews.text: Had Saturday afternoon lunch, 4 adults and 2 children. Food was great and the service was even better. Always nice when staff offer to rearrange furniture to accommodate buggies and high chairs. Bar was immaculate and well stocked. Pub grub food was top notch. Nice atmosphere in the pub made for a very enjoyable afternoon. Cheers guys.

We had such a wonderful time at the Victoria Inn. The room was super spacious and very clean. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful and full of charm. The attached pub was especially great. The food, from breakfast to dinner, was exquisite, and both the wines and beers were delicious. Thank you, Del, for your warm and incredibly friendly manner; we felt completely at ease. Thank you, Del, for your generous hospitality. We would love to come back again :)

We stayed at The Victoria Inn while visiting the 58th Street. The staff were incredibly accommodating and helpful from the moment we arrived. The room was simple but just what was needed. The bed was comfy and it was good to have a pod coffee machine in the room and even better that this included decaf coffee. We went down to the bar for a drink in the evening and the pub had a great atmosphere and good choice of drinks on tap. Breakfast was very good. A good selection and very tasty when it arrived. A special mention needs to be given to Carl who worked incredibly hard and was very friendly.

Stopped here recently for a couple of days as my son lives in Peckham and couldn't fault the staff, room or location.
Check in was super smooth...I got there a bit too early to check in but was hoping to leave my bag. The lovely lady on reception checked with house-keeping and my room was ready so was able to get to my room then. The room was perfect for me not huge but big enough with really nice decor and lovely bathroom. Decent coffee machine & bottles of water in room which was a nice touch. Quiet room, didn't hear any noise/traffic despite in being in a relatively busy area.
The team working there were always friendly and chatty when I saw them. I didnt eat in the pub below but did have a few drinks one night..very cosy and friendly atmosphere.
Few mins walk to Peckham Rye Train station and convenient bus links and I felt safe walking to & from them on my own at night.
Will definitely stay here again when visiting. 💚

Had a great 4 day stay at the Victoria Inn in Peckham for a visit with a dozen friends! Del was a lovely host- looking after a smooth check in and taking great care throughout our whole stay. Food in the restaurant was good and bar staff was also excellent. Lots of food options, stores and Pubs within walking distance. Rooms were clean and comfortable.

name: The Camberwell Arms
address: 65 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text:
Enjoyed my birthday dinner here and had a lovely time.

The scotch bonnet pork fat on toast was so good, I just wish I could’ve had 10 of them.

The broccoli “cacio e Pepe” with toasted buckwheat was good and did remind me of eating a cream pasta. The sauce was great to eat with bread too!

The fish, which I now can’t remember what it was, was so delicate, zesty and delicious. The mash was creamy and smooth and the combination of everything on the plate was perfect.

They kindly gave me a birthday surprise of rhubarb spritz sorbet ice cream

This a double review. One for the restaurant in general, which is reliably one of the best restaurants south of the river. The menu is always innovative and fresh but with classic cuisine at it’s heart. The staples that are always there like beer onions on toast, their incredible focaccia and their legendary Sunday roasts are always a 10/10.
The second half of the review is for Camberwell Arms’ catering of our wedding reception. Throughout the engagement Matilde was very easy to contact and thorough with the process of helping us select the menu and plan the day. After much back and forth customising the menu, at our tasting we were made to feel right at home and finished off with a further session with the chef to add any other bespoke elements to the dishes that had been prepared. This included a last minute request for a spare rib based canapé which was fulfilled and was the star of the pre dinner reception!
The food for 75 people which included their famous porchetta and a show stopping Paris Brest was served on the day with no hiccups whatsoever.
The night was finished with their sfincione which was also a hit and was completely hoovered up by the guests.
I can’t recommend Camberwell arms highly enough - whether it’s for a wedding, an evening dinner with friends or a Sunday roast.

The Camberwell Arms is one of the most reliable pubs for excellent food and warm service in south London. The menu is generous and seasonal, with dishes that feel both comforting and refined. The dining room has an easy, unpretentious charm, and the staff strike the right balance between attentive and relaxed. It works just as well for a quiet dinner as it does for a larger gathering. Consistently delicious food and a welcoming atmosphere make it a standout neighbourhood favourite. Delicious sprouts, gotta love the crunch.

It's taken us a while to get a Sunday booking here, but after our recent meal I can see why they're so popular! We really enjoyed their refreshingly original take on a Sunday roast that still celebrates the flavours and ingredients of the season. We were particularly impressed at the portion of the main meats, which although pricey, provided very good value for money. I was very grateful that the staff were knowledgeable and confident on gluten free options - our waitress quickly brought over a menu marked up with hand written notes on what was safe and what could be accommodated. We were so full from the meal that we opted to share the peanut parfait for dessert, but it was so moreish we found ourselves wishing we had ordered two. Really looking forward to coming back again soon to this cozy and inviting pub.

I’m confused by all the good reviews and highly disappointed by the roast we had last Sunday. My friends and I arrived and were standing around for about 10 minutes without being greeted and without acknowledgment. We then told an employee we had a booking which took staff a while to figure out where we were sat. The decor is bleak and service slow. Waiting staff seemed confused, forgetting parts of our orders and brining the wrong cutlery or missing cutlery like steak knives for our meal. The food was cold, and I assume would’ve tasted better if hot but still seemed quite flavourless. My friends and I are all disappointing to have paid for the meal even though we had asked for the service charge to be taken off it still felt like daylight robbery. Would not recommend or go back for even just a pint tbh. Broccoli was basically just a thick stalk with tiny florets on it. Bloody Mary was super average. It’s a shame because we heard good things about this roast and were all so excited for it…

name_normalised: 805 restaurants west african restaurant old kent
address: 805 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NX, UK

reviews.text: Great restaurant serving traditional West African food in a sleek and modern environment. We went on a Saturday evening and - although very busy - managed to get a table for two without reservation. Staff was friendly and explained the dishes to us. The grilled fish was excellent- but order only if you are OK with bones. The Asaro was very special, spiced and hearty. Would recommend!

I was a bit hesitant to try this place at first, given the mixed reviews, but all of my concerns were quickly put to rest.
We visited around midday and were warmly welcomed by Yetunde, who provided excellent customer service from start to finish. Our food arrived quickly and it was absolutely delicious. Big shoutout to Chef Ben!
The portion sizes were generous, even if they looked smaller at first glance and the interior was surprisingly stylish and comfortable, much nicer than you'd guess from the outside.
Overall a fantastic experience. Highly recommended!

I came all the way from North London to Old Kent Road 805 to get food. I asked for seafood Okro with poundo and Edikaikong soup with poundo.
This decision was my worst nightmare. Absolutely disgusting food, seafood what? Waste of time, effort and money.
The vegetable I was served, first wasn’t Edikaikong, secondly it had no flavour whatsoever. The worst food I ever ate.
I called the store once I got home and realised that it wasn’t Edikaikong I was served, I heard the chef saying it was, then, the man who answered the phone, instead of asking for a phone number or something to be able to request a photo, I insisted that I called back the day after, then they can give me a mobile number to send images to because it’s store closing time. NEVER AGAIN!!!

I have been a loyal patron since 2004, and this restaurant remains one of my all-time favorite Nigerian dining experiences in London. The rich flavors and authentic dishes always transport me back to the heart of Nigeria.

It is always a very pleasant experience for us whenever we come here, be it together or with others. The attentiveness of the staff is always 10/10. They ensure that everything is okay with our food and are always accessible if we need them for anything. The food is delicious and full of a variety of flavours and spices.👌🏾

As we are both lovers of art, the decor always really stands out to us, especially the beautiful portraits. They depict a West African tale. Simply magnificent!

Overall, the restaurant is exceptionally clean and we never have any issues when we dine here with food, cutlery, the atmosphere or the staff. 805 has continued to uphold their high standards over the years hence why we always come back!
It was my first time at Ganapati, and we were absolutely delighted with the food. The starters were amazing, and we shared a couple of mains that were just as delicious. We can’t wait to go back!

Great restaurant, the foods amazing, friendly staff and loved the dimly lit ambience. They must be doing something right as they have been open for 20 years. Need to book in advance as they are always busy.

The food was amazing as was the hospitality of the super friendly owner herself, the talented chefs and Johann our server.

He is an artist in the way he delivers the menu choices. We had decision paralysis as everything sounded so good. He asked what we liked, if we had any allergies and recommended dishes accordingly. Haven't seen anyone enjoy what they do in such a long while and also do it well!! He could sell water to a fish!

Would recommend.
Had fantastic Indian food here, with authentic flavours and a good variety of veg food. Don't miss the beetroot dosa or the dal paneer with paratha. I'm surely going back again.

There were 20 of us at the weekend for our dad's 86th birthday and the team couldn't have been more accommodating! Johann handled everything perfectly including managing 6 children and ordering a selection for all the adults. The food was delicious (as always) and everyone was very happy! Would go again in a heartbeat!

🚇 Peckham Rye
🍺 £6.90 Estrella Galacia

The Angel Oak is located opposite the top end of Peckham Rye Park in Peckham, southeast London. The nearest station is Peckham Rye.

This pub was built in the mid-19th century and was originally called The Rye Hotel, later becoming Rye House. In recent years, the pub was known simply as The Rye until it was refurbished and renamed The Angel Oak in 2021.

This is a large, one-bar, multi-room pub with a contemporary feel. The main bar area is located at the front and features a centrally positioned servery. The bar area has high ceilings and mixed seating, including benches, booths, and traditional tables and chairs. To the back left of the servery is a dining area, which then leads to a huge beer garden at the rear. The decor consists of boarded floors, bold pastel painted walls, an eclectic mix of prints and artworks, a few large Tv’s, and modern light fixtures.

The beer selection was solid and offered premium continental lagers and locally brewed craft beers. There were cask pumps, but they were not in use. I opted for an Estrella Galicia; my pint was great, price point was high. The food menu consists of pub classics — fish and chips cost £18, and roasts are available on Sundays.

I arrived at 5pm on a mild Saturday afternoon in August. The pub was absolutely packed throughout, with a predominantly younger crowd. There was a real upbeat buzz about the place while the Leeds v Newcastle match was showing live on the projector screen. The service was good; I didn’t have to wait too long to be served, and the team were coping well under pressure.

All told, this was an enjoyable pub visit — and it was great to see a pub so busy on a Saturday afternoon. My pint was spot on, the surroundings were comfortable, the beer garden was a big bonus, and the hospitality was pleasant. Be sure to check this one out if you’re in the area.

We had an incredible sunday roast! The food was very lovely and the beer selection was fantastic. We were looked after by Saffi, who was super friendly, attentive, and accommodating. Definitely one of the best roast spots around Peckham for sure. We will be coming back :)

I’ve been a regular customer at the pub for nearly three years, as I live just a two-minute walk away. I usually really enjoy the food – the chicken and bacon wrap at lunchtime is a favourite, and the burger is also very good (especially with added bacon).
However, I was quite disappointed with my experience today. I ordered the steak sandwich, which was unfortunately terrible – the meat was tough, completely flavourless, and practically impossible to chew. I also ordered a chicken sandwich for my daughter, which was just about acceptable, but the chicken was clearly dry and tasted as though it had been cooked several days ago.
It’s a shame, as I normally enjoy the food here, but today’s meal was well below the usual standard.

My family and I came here for Sunday roast to celebrate several family birthdays.  The food was absolutely amazing, the staff were brilliant and the service was excellent.  We have been a number of times before and would definitely come here again.

Had a lovely afternoon drinking pints here last week. Great chat with the bartender, Kwame, and the other punters were very nice and chilled too. Didn't have the food so unfortunately can't comment on that but will be coming back again to try it!

It’s convenient because there’s a parking lot inside. It costs £12 per day.
The car park has an attendant, making it safe to park.

Fantastic place in south London for events and pop ups.
There is various different units offering different services from west African food, vintage antiques markets yoga and more. I passed by here on my journeys during the winter so it was very quiet however judging by its location and things to offer I can see this place becoming very busy during the London summer.

I was there for the Independent Ceramics Market, and not only was the market fantastic, Copeland Park itself is a great space with a ton going on!! Wish I lived closer so I could check out more events

Rooftop film club is a magic summer experience. Comfortable seats, easy food & drinks order, great sound & image quality. Great atmosphere, superb location, kind staff, delicious simple food (e.g. mozzarela garlic bread).  Totally recommend!

A real place of hope, creativity and authenticity. It’s like stepping into Diagon Alley and discovering magical small businesses, charming places to eat, drink, connect with like-minded people!
A place to relax, to discover, to meet and have fun! Highly recommend 🌟

name: Silk Road
address: 47 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8TR, UK

reviews.text: The food here is quite good but depending on which dish you order - we love the hand pulled noodles delicious but one of the dish we ordered , shish lamb noodle dish doesn’t have much flavour apart form cumin - I would not recommend this dish. Having said that the other dishes were really good. I would definitely recommend this place but choose your dish wisely.

We were big fans of this place in its rustic former incarnation, so worried about the refurbishment, but fears were unfounded. It’s been done really tastefully and the food is better than we remembered it. Somehow the prices don’t seem to have been bumped up for the renovation either. The pork with black fungus, as well as the aubergine were particularly memorable.

The food smelled great and the restaurant was surprisingly nice and modern. They seemed to have a lot of lamb on the menu but when we got the dish it was definitely beef being sold as lamb with hardly much meat in general. As a chef myself I can tell the difference. Also ordered what was supposed to be chive and shrimp dumplings but again lacking the protein and seemed to be mainly just chives. To end, the waiters could be friendlier.

Don't get the hype. Food is quite oily and service is average. Good for those who love the szechuan peppers flavour and looking for a quick feed. Portion sizes, especially the noodles are large and prices are decent but unsure if this worth travelling out of the way for. Would have liked more protein in the noodles and more flavour in the cucumber salad

Seriously impressed! Food was fresh, hot and delicious. We particularly enjoyed the hand pulled noodles with chicken dish. Was so so good!

The service was superb, friendly and efficient. My wife and I enjoyed everything ordered with our two sons who have just moved to Camberwell. I think Silk Road will become a firm favoured return spot for them! Loved it!

name: M.Manze
address: 105 Peckham High St, London SE15 5RS, UK

reviews.text: There simply needs to be more of these places making headlines in the London area. Just simple, delicious, food served by friendly people. You can’t ask for anything more and sure, it’s not the most amazing pie and mash that I have ever had, but the atmosphere and history of the place speaks for itself and the price is right on. I would happily recommend M.Manze to anyone wishing to have an authentic and real experience with great British scran.

A True London Classic – Manze’s Never Disappoints!

Manze’s in Peckham is a gem of traditional London heritage. I popped in for pie and mash, and left feeling like I’d stepped back into a golden era of honest, comforting food. The pie was perfectly baked, packed with rich, savory filling, and the mash was smooth and creamy—just how it should be. But the real star? That legendary liquor. Fresh, herby, and utterly nostalgic.

The staff were warm and welcoming, and the old-school atmosphere adds to the whole experience. It’s rare to find a place that holds onto its roots while still serving up quality with every plate.

If you want a real taste of London, this is the place. Can’t wait to return!

Manze's is still good. I've been going here with my dad for years and that won't change. The Pie n mash is amazing, mash is nice and smooth and the pie is just as great and for a great value for money. I'll always love the old school feel with the place.

I can not recommend the place enough.
Simply the best pie and mash I’ve ever eaten. Nobody does it better.
Incredibly friendly pie, mash and liquor shop. The pies are lovely and beefy, the mash is smooth and creamy and the liquor is savory and full of parsley. Try the locally made saspirilla too!.

reviews.text: Absolutely delicious restaurant-quality Chinese food and friendly customer service too. Highly recommend the set meal for 2 which they allowed me to make a couple of changes to. The food came quickly (30 mins!) and was piping hot and all the flavours were lovely. In particular the chicken crispy noodles were fab and the crispy shredded beef with chilli was probably the best I've ever had. Give these guys a go!
Rice and soup a tiny bit bland but the service is great, really sweet staff. Good prices

I've been ordering from this restaurant for a while . I think it's almost been about 7 years. Maybe more and I don't think I've ever had an issue with the food. The food is always up to standards and is affordable . Furthermore, the delivery time is quick and staff friendly .No complaints here .

Food was bland and had no taste. Chicken ball burnt again!! Noodles taste watery and food has no taste.
Avoid poor food!!!
Have bought from here before but in the last year the food quality has deteriorated drastically. I won't be back!!!
Always done collection so can't comment on delivery, but the food is always excellent, hot, and I've never been kept waiting upon collection. Fantastic! (Oh and you DO get free prawn crackers! )

Sadly ordered a Singapore fried rice and there wasn’t nothing Singapore about it! It was just a special fried rice with loads of onions added.  There was zero spice, on the menu it clearly states “hot&spicy” and they used tinned ham/spam.. not feeling.

Full Garden is hands down my favourite Chinese restaurant in London.
I’ve been coming here for over 20 years, and it never disappoints. The food is consistently delicious, authentic, and made with care. Even after all these years, it’s still worth the journey across London every time. That says it all.

I ordered special fried rice and chicken balls with sweet and sour sauce .Well,what can I say, the rice appeared  ok,but the chicken balls were horrible, dark and the batter on them was questionable (I tried 2)The recipe has changed for the worse.I had a dodgy stomach  a few hours later from the balls or rice or both .This place used to be good but has gone downhill which is a shame,
Avoid.

The best Chinese restaurant in Peckham; possibly the world; indeed, I think, the universe!!!

No need to venture into Dulwich or the city - the quality of this simple Peckham 'Chinese Takeaway' is simply excellent. Their food? Delicious!

What more can I say? I've eaten at a range of Chinese restaurants
all over London and Full Garden is right up there with the best.

I usually order by phone and pick up my meal, so I don't usually wait for too long

Well worth a visit.

I have been ordering for years now and I have never had a bad experience.⭐️ Food excellent ⭐️Service Excellent always my go to Chinese Takeaway. We recently moved from the area about 45mins away and still use even though there are closer ones by our new house.

I had amala, gbegiri, and ewedu at Lolak Peckham, with classic Barrister music playing in the background. Honestly, it felt like I was back in Nigeria. The food tasted proper Naija ✅

I was so satisfied that I literally got up and danced after eating 😄. It gave real buka vibes, and the food was delicious — it truly gave what it was supposed to give. 😊

This place is the best buka vibe in the UK I have been to. I keep coming back.

Food is very delicious and portions are massive. Vibe is good too.

There is parking out front.

I couldn't even finish my food.

My first visit, I enjoyed the food and the company.
I was rather disappointed at the restaurant and decor and the toilet left a lot to be desired.
For a place of culture more investment is needed.

I think this was a decent place considering that we went late on an Easter Monday (bank holiday). The prices were fair, but there was really no display of what we were dished so we didn’t see what we were being served; this I consider not good enough. Staff were excellent, literally at our beck and call, but the stew had too much pepper😃😃

Avoid if you're looking to introduce someone to Nigerian cuisine for the first time. It's basically a glorified "Mama Put". Food was mediocre but reasonably priced for the portion size. Customer Service? What's that? Go and Customer Service yourself. Why are we Nigerians unserious when it comes to presenting a nice, clean and socially endearing food establishment? Some will say, "It's Peckham! What were you expecting?" I can't argue. Na me carry my two legs waka there. Last time.

I’m quite particular when it comes to Chinese food, and I’m not a fan of the typical takeaway style that uses too much food colouring and cornstarch. I’m really glad I found this place!

I ordered the roasted pork fried rice  it was delicious, perfectly seasoned, and the portion size was generous enough for two people. I also tried the Chinese dumplings with chilli oil (you have to buy separate), and they were fantastic. I absolutely love chilli oil, and theirs was exceptional rich, fragrant, and full of flavour.

Just a heads-up: they are takeaways only and accept cash only, so make sure to bring some if you’re planning to visit.

I’ve been using this shop for years now; around 15. The present owner is a very loverly, courteous, happy lady! Up until this day, she won’t tell me her name! 😂
Nonetheless, the food has always been tops. The king prawn fried rice and its noodle equivalent, is the best in Peckham. Pepper wings are very yummy too. Must not forget my Chips most Fridays better than most in the area. Highly recommended!
I ordered a large king prawn fried rice only to discover a half dead fly in my food. Disgusted to say the least.
Was going on they have been closed for over a month 😵😟
Best Chinese in Peckham , order the King prawn dishes , egg rice and mixed vegetables .

reviews.text: It’s truly heartbreaking that a place I once looked forward to visiting for a lovely meal has now become somewhere I no longer enjoy going to. I bought T. Beans from the Peckham store, and it was full of sand  I had to throw it away. I decided to give the Catford store a try, but to my surprise, it was even worse. I’m extremely disappointed. I’ve wasted almost £40 in just three days.

It was my first time of visiting Peckham and I was so hungry needed a delicious African meal. I asked around and someone recommended this place. I decided to try it out with my friend. We both ordered egusi soup and pounded yam. It was sumptuous 😊🥰. It is really hard for someone to satisfy me with egusi soup but to my greatest surprise, Tasty African food did. I will recommend this place for their nice meals. However, their customer attending skill is poor and I would recommend they try put in more effort. We were eating and my friend needed a tooth pick. First of all, meal was served without toothpick…come on who does that? ..so we requested for it and she told us to come pick it up…like😞😞….my friend who was still eating, had to leave her sit to get it and that was it.

with a friend of mine who is also a chef like me, we decided to try again to eat African, this time the experience was incredibly surprising because all really good foods, different but well prepared combinations, and as a motorcyclist as I have been for years I also really appreciate the generous portions as in this case were, truly surprising for those of us who are looking for new dining experiences; few seats to eat on the spot but for a place that mainly deals with takeaway food I can say that it is a small detail really appreciated
I bought efo riro today and I must say I was very impressed with the portion size and quality of the food. I will definitely come back 👍🏾

Must be a change of management?
● SPOTLESS!! Store; Friendly attentive staff; Fantastic food.
● This is now my new "go-to" branch.
● Up till now, it's been...(the still wonderful)...Leyton Branch.

name: KHF Peckham
address: 35 Peckham High St, London SE15 5EB, UK

reviews.text: i grabbed some food from khf peckham and was really happy with how tasty everything was. the chicken was tender and well seasoned, and the portions were great for the price. i’d definitely stop by again when i’m in the area.

I normally order food from here online but today I visited in person. The place was nice and clean with the option to eat inside or just order food for takeout. I really liked the customer service I received as the gentleman who served me was friendly and polite throughout. Great team atmosphere and very reasonably priced compared to other places I've visited locally.A++
KHF Peckham has a laid-back vibe, and the BBQ wings are decent, but not exceptional. This branch closes at early, so for a better experience and later hours, KHF Stepney is the way to go.

Food is 10/10 the best chicken shop in south east in my opinion better than south London Morley’s.

The boss man always looks after me when I’m in Peckham.
Best I always come here. Workers are nice and friendly and it's just good, cheap food

address: 27A Peckham High St, London SE15 5EB, UK

reviews.text:
I got rice&peas with oxtail and coleslaw this is a small this was £10  and a portion of jerk chicken was £6 so in total it was only £16 pound for this which I didn’t even finish took the rest home.

The food tastes very nice and clean.

Shop was also clean and very nice guy at the till he took his time to explain what comes with the dishes which was really lovely.

Overall I would say 9/10 food was really good and really excited to try their other dishes soon

Suchhhh flavourful and juicy chicken that fell off the bone. The coleslaw wasn’t too mayonnaisey and there wasn’t too much - over doing the chicken so grateful for that. There was plenty of chicken - great portion size. Jerk sauce was so rich, rice perfectly cooked and my craving for jerk chicken at 13 on a Sunday afternoon has been satisfied.

Lovely friendly set up and staff. Not too much seating but of course mostly takeout. Cash and card.

Perfect for an amazing meal that will fill you up and taste amazing

Best meal we had in London, visiting from Toronto and New York area. Small local spot with amazing Jamaican food and affordable; we ordered the oxtail and jerk chicken. Halal too! Owner was SO kind and it was her birthday. Loved visiting and will we back when we are back in town
Unfortunately, I was served chicken, which was undercooked. I had to throw it away. Please ensure your food is cooked thoroughly.

Insanely good! We had to try this place during a visit to London from Somerset and not only was the food incredible but the friendly service and hospitality was amazing. Cannot wait to come back when we next visit London again! Thanks so much 🫶

reviews.text:
I had a brilliant time at the Prince of Peckham Pub — such a fun, buzzing spot right in the heart of Peckham! The atmosphere is warm and welcoming whether you’re meeting friends for drinks, grabbing some food, or staying late for music and dancing. The staff were friendly and attentive, which made the whole visit really enjoyable. Their cocktails are fantastic, perfect for starting the night right. The food is tasty and satisfying too, with jerk-inspired dishes that pack plenty of flavour. The interior has a great energy with plenty of space to relax, socialise

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a vibrant bar with great drinks, a lively crowd and memorable nights out!

The food here was unbelievably good. I had a Jerk Bun and it was massive, and so flavourful. My partner had a cauliflower bun and it was also delicious. Plus, we had such a friendly waitress, wish I got her name to shout her out! Will definitely be returning

Visited this Pub 2 months ago. Had lovely chicken and rice and a cocktail as I started. Indoor was packed as it was a weekend night and was very busy, so I got a seat outside.

Food

Chicken and rice were excellent. Rich in flavour, texture and cooked well.

I decided to go indoors when I some seats got vacant. Got a table at the corner and ordered a drink and their chicken wings with honey glaze. It was the best chicken wings I had so far. Crispy, tasty, and with right flavour. It had a flavourful ginger zing to it which elevated the taste experience.

Love to go back.

Ps: I am not able to upload any photos as I haven’t taken any. I will be uploading the photos when I go back there.

Overall verdict: 4.7

A year ago I came here, the jerk chicken plate was good.

But today... A very disappointing meal/wasted time and money

the food was beyond disappointment 😥 ended up in Costa after to wash it away.

I came during very quite times,  so I was very confused at the bad quality of food (burned chicken which was mainly made up of very burned skin and hard to chew, bland rice and beans meant to be rice and peas, and strings of raw tasteless cabbage served as coleslaw. The young waiter was not getting much help so customer service was not great (not his fault)

For 20.00 (15 for the meal, 5 for side of plantains).... Was not a good experience. Won't be risking it again.

I asked for a refund but the young waiter had to find the manager and I had to go.

Overall.... A very disappointing meal/wasted time and money

Hands down… go for the rum punch! Got on that bus late but man was it packing a punch! The vibe was amazing. DJ was spinning Afrobeat jams, bar gets crowded but second floor bar is available. Enough room for everybody and their mamas to dance off their feet! Atmosphere is just outstanding!

address: 10 Peckham High St, London SE15 5DT, UK

reviews.text:
I'd say the best Morley's I've tried so far. Chicken is just brilliant, staff here is always friendly, do food so quickly.

Maybe even it's one of the best chicken shops in London I had
To be honest this Morleys isn't too bad, but I don't unserdtand is that they ALWAYS drown the chicken fillet burger in mayo, you can barely enjoy the burger, it's comletely ridiculous.
Took forever to give me my food.

This morleys once had 5 stars from me.
Now it's just gone down hill just got bbq wings and chips.
Chips needed longer and the chicken was really dry. Quality of the chicken is poor clearly very cheap.
Think I'll stop buying from here disappointed.
The workers I used to see don't see no more. Under new management maybe.
Decent food for its price. It tasted nice, too, except for the chips, it wasnt seasoned with salt at all. It seemed to be run by one person. The atmosphere needs more work, maybe.

reviews.text: They are total crazy

Definitely recommend this place for everyone! The place is so cozy, with diverse and lovely furniture, like a different fantasy when you come. The flat white is also very great. If I had chance to visit here again, I will definitely visit this place again.

This place is awesome. Its so quirky and has a rooftop bar and cafe which is open during the week. The views over central London are amazing. We went because they put in arts performances at the weekends. Been to 2 so far, the first being a double piano recital which was awesome. It's actually a disused multi storey carpark that's been turned into an arts centre. It's a surreal experience sitting on chairs arranged on a concrete floor but it works. Worth checking out. It is funded by private doners so not commercial. Going to 2 more performances later in the year. London symphony orchestra and Rachmaninoff.

I will say that this is a very interesting building with small businesses inside like shops, bars, and takeaways and has a big rootop bar with an amazing view of London. The facilities inside are very run down, and there are hardly any directions with multiple entrances and no parking.

Loved the food from The Grub Club. Definitely a highlight of the place. A place to gather and chill and hang out with pretty much most of what you'd need if you have good company. Music, a bar, a few places to eat,  karaoke. The karaoke room is very small but still a decent place to enjoy when in the company of friends.

Thoroughly enjoyed the visit here. I was there visiting a friend who had a jewellery making workshop. Got some lovely food from the bar aswell. Full of stalls from crafting materials to home made preserves. It's a great place to spend a rainy Sunday.

name: Steamer

reviews.text:
Orders vegetables fried rice . Big portion Great price 😋Good quality rice with Lots vegetables including mushroom, cabbage, broccoli, coriander... 5 vege a day simply done here !
The reason I like this place is their friendly service, welcoming atmosphere, feeling like home :)

I love the food. Well priced, good
Portion size, really tasty. They’re lovely as well. Top marks all round.

So glad we found this place again (he’s recently moved location). This place is worthy of more than five stars. The best steam buns in London by a mile. The squid is a huge portion and the prices are more than affordable for London. The owner I think works alone, so he’s often busy but seemingly very hard working - (always a good sign you’ve made a good food choice). It’s well worth the visit, you’ll not be disappointed!
Excellent food, great value for money, and decent portions. I’ve visited several times and each time the food is great.

Best Chinese food in London! Real hidden gem - the place is nothing fancy, but the food is amazing,well priced and the guy who runs it is so friendly. All the dishes are good but I like the spring rolls and noodles with blackbean sauce. The portions are very generous with lots of fresh veg and ingredients, which makes it quite healthy, unlike most other Chinese takeouts where there is only noodles and beansprouts. In summary, Peckham Steamer is great. Shame they didn't do delivery, but worth the travel to get.

reviews.text: The most amazing branch me and my family have been to! The staff were so friendly and nice, they really took good care of us. We went for my brother’s bday and we really enjoyed the food, very good and big portions. We got the buffalo chicken, smash burger and honest burger with buffalo and bbq wings.

Honest burgers are always good and reliable. You won’t have a culinary experience but you know you’ll have good-priced burgers with reasonable quality. Each branch makes things a bit different. In this one, the fries were too salty. Also, the background music was too loud, which some may like, while others may find annoying as it makes it close to impossible to have a conversation. Overall, if you’re in the area and hungry and want a burger, honest is an option that never fails.

Ordered from here on uber eats and was excited as I normally love honest burgers. This is the worst meal I’ve ever received. I ordered my burger medium well and received two raw cold beef patties, the onion rings were also soggy and drowning oil. The slaw was only filled to a quarter of the container and I’d say was two spoons full. This is not my first time ordering from honest burgers but this branch is actually criminal. I was starving but could barely eat anything because everything but the fries was inedible. Beware for food poisoning from this place, I’m so upset because I’ve wasted my money, I’m still hungry and  I feel sick from the bite I took of the burger 🤢

I got the double smash burger with halloumi, and its probably the best burger i’ve had in the UK, and i have had a LOT of burgers here. I also got the homemade mint lemonade because lemonade is my favorite drink, and its suuuuuper good!

Ordered a delivery through uber eats. I live approximately 5 mins away on a bike etc, the food was picked up and took over 30 mins for the delivery driver to arrive at my house. Watching the delivery persons route it looked like he drove off somewhere and stopped for 20 mins before deciding to bring us our food. By this point the food was ice cold/frozen.

Realistically this is more of an uber eats issue, I brought it up with them and they said it was delivered in time and don’t care if the food was frozen. I only am leaving this review because I brought it up to honest burgers and was ignored so just generally terrible customer service all around, and also I am out £45 because the food I ordered was basically inedible.

I went into beer rebellion today on my way to another bar, and thank god I choose this place instead. The lovely Italian lady behind the bar (I think Mia) brightened my day and even gave me some great recommendations for the area ! The rest of the staff were also there having a drink and they all seem to love their jobs and each other. Can’t wait to go back ! Love you BR

Genuinely one of the most welcoming bars you’re going to find in Peckham. The staff are amazing and truly friendly. From the first day I met the staff the treated me so well that I’ve been coming back here so often.

Perfect place to do work and they bar has events from time to time.
Super friendly place, great selection of IPAs / modern beers. Never had any food there hence a neutral 3.

Very lovely place to have a variety of Beers, and different drinks. My favourite is number 7.
Close to Queen Road Peckham Station, and different bus routes. I definitely recommend the place.
I liked it, nothing fancy but it was warm and I could have stayed all day.. girl at the bar is very nice and friendly

I don't often post negative reviews and especially in this case it was a tough decision to make because historically the place has been great and the fish was always good, but on this occasion the fried chicken was unedible. It tasted like expired meat. Whatever the reason is, please sort it out because it's taking away from what used to be a great place

I went to this place expecting a good meal. What I have just seen is shocking. I have ordered a chicken doner and specifically requested for him to cut the doner in front of me. He mixed the pre-ready meal box and he mixed it with the fresh chicken doner. The meat is not cooked well, I ordered a portion of chips and I requested for it to be extra-cooked. He didn’t cook it properly and it turned out to be soggy. The chicken doner also smelled.

Service is rubbish, when he was preparing it for takeaway, he didn’t put any tissue, nor a fork or knife.

Never go to this place, absolutely rubbish. Explains why it is empty.

Have had kebabs , chips n chicken fillet burgers from here and all were really tasty .
Delivery was fast and prices reasonable for the quality of the food .

READ THE REVIEWS ABOUT THE SERVICE BEFORE ORDERING. The manager is one of the rudest people I’ve ever come across. TRASH FOOD.  My order came in 20 mins of me ordering and she admitted on the phone that she had just given me the last batch and she isn’t cooking anymore as she “doesn’t cook wings past this time”. She actually admitted that she COOKED this and deemed it good enough to sell!!!
Upon me telling her that she got my order wrong she said “NO, I didn’t”. She said she’ll issue a refund for the wings if she can pick the wings up later which I suspect is to SELL TO ANOTHER INVDIVIDUAL.
Whilst confirming I was a refund and will be leaving a review of my service today she hung up!!! She DIDN’T EVEN APOLOGISE.

Just look at the disgusting wings and terrible - BROKEN, box that the wings came in!!!

I normally order from them and they’ve been excellent but definitely won’t order again if that’s who they have in charge of the place.

Lastly the delivery guy was extremely lovely but didn’t keep a safe distance when delivering even though I asked him to through the front door.

Disgusting service from the manager and disgusting quality of food today. TRASH.
Terrible dog er meat honestly the most awful wrap I ever had in my life I have ever ordered food took to long to arrive also cane cold and it’s not even proper dohner meat

Artusi is a charming and authentic yet trendy Italian restaurant in London that beautifully balances tradition and modern flair. The menu stays true to classic Italian roots, offering a thoughtful selection of dishes made with clear passion and top-quality ingredients. Each plate is presented with care, showcasing both simplicity and elegance. The restaurant itself has a warm, cozy atmosphere, and the friendly staff bring a genuine Italian vibe that makes you feel instantly welcome. While I found the portions a little on the smaller side, every bite was flavorful and satisfying, leaving me appreciating the quality over quantity. Overall, Artusi is a delightful spot for anyone seeking an authentic Italian dining experience with a touch of contemporary style.

Fab lunch at Artusi. On Sundays it is a set menu, which makes it more manageable for the staff and is also easier if you have a member in your party that finds making dish selections tricky... ;) The dishes were imaginative, very tasty and of decent portions. Large selection of Negronis. Attentive service. I wish there wasn't a time limit on our stay to make it a proper Italian meal experience... Will definitely be back.

A truly excellent food experience. Dishes are lovingly and expertly prepared. There's a home cooked feel to the dishes yet there's also sophistication. Me is change frequently, The ingredients were seasonal. Definitely worth coming back many times over
Good place for the chef’s menu. Cozy and cute but it was really stuffy inside and too warm.

A nice restaurant, vibe and idea in theory. The drinks were lovely and bread and butter were lovely. Some of our party liked the fennel salad a lot but it wasn’t for me. I was the only vegetarian and it did feel like my dish was an afterthought…it was quite bland and all the dishes were quite small so I did leave quite hungry. Didn’t get very welcoming vibes from staff unfortunately!

De'osa did an excellent job catering for our wedding day! Would definitely recommend if you want amazing food and service. Rita and the team went above and beyond and we were extremely grateful. Great attention to detail and everyone's needs were catered to (we had some with allergies which they accommodated). No complaints, all the guests loved the food. Thank you once again Deosa x

We honestly can’t speak highly enough of Rita and her husband! From the moment they arrived, they went above and beyond to make our wedding day so special. It wasn’t just about the food (which was INCREDIBLE)—it was the care, love, and attention to detail they brought to everything they did.

Rita even brought things we hadn’t thought of ourselves—she was so prepared, thoughtful, and genuinely caring. We felt completely looked after, and it made such a difference on a day that can be so hectic.

And the food? The flavours, the presentation, everything was just top-tier.

You can tell they pour their heart into their work, and it shows in every single part of the service. We’re so thankful and wouldn’t hesitate for a second to recommend them. If you’re thinking about booking—do it. You won’t regret it!

— Emma & Mekke 🩷🩷🩷

We have been De’Osa’d!!!
We used them for our Nigerian-Salone wedding and honestly, they went above and beyond for us both before and after the wedding. They catered so beautifully to both our cultures – I still have guests calling me asking where they can find that cassava leaf! The food was truly sensational, 10/10. If you ask them to cater for 400 people, they’ll cater for 5,000 – we went home with so much food, and they took the time and care to pack everything up into our cars for us. It was amazing not having to cook for weeks after the wedding haha!

Their staff were extremely professional, the buffet was so well organised, and there were no long queues – everything flowed perfectly.

But beyond the food, what stood out most was their genuine love and care for us as their clients. They were checking in on us, praying for us before and after the wedding, and making sure we were okay throughout. Even after the wedding, they helped us deal with issues we had with other vendors and really stood up and advocated for us. Rita was always telling me not to worry or stress about anything because she would handle it – and she absolutely handled it!

I honestly felt like I’d found family in them. Now I’m just thinking of what event I can plan next just so I can use them again!

Highly, highly recommend. Thank you for making our day so special ❤️

Would have loved to have used their services but they have not responded to any of my email enquiries. Tried twice (under my billing email address) but nothing. A simple "yes we can" or "no we can't" would have been nice.  I judge a company on how they respond to enquiries and complaints as it forms part of the overall service. The enquiry form / email address should be removed from the site if no-one bothers checking it.

I recently attended a wedding catered by De’Osa, and the experience was nothing short of exceptional. Every dish was beautifully presented, perfectly seasoned, and bursting with authentic flavor. The staff’s warmth and professionalism added a special touch, making the event truly unforgettable. I can confidently say I was completely De’Osa-ed! I highly recommend them for any occasion—absolute perfection!

Lovely cosy atmosphere with delicious food! I thought the £40 set menu was great value for loads of food. I loved the wine list full of amazing wines and the delicious cocktails were amazing. Each dish was so flavourful and beautifully presented. Service was friendly and speedy. My only let down was the custard tart which was a little flat and small and not up to the same quality as the rest of the dishes, especially for the price. Overall, I can’t wait to return!

Went here for a birthday meal and opted for the all in menu.
Each course was flavourful, original and well presented, and enjoyed the variety of dishes. Really great selection of wines. Was able to try one before ordering a bottle which I always appreciate.
Great value for money too.
Will definitely go back to try another months menu and cocktails.

I recently dined at the Omni Restaurant in Peckham, trying their £40 per person taster menu. The small plates were surprisingly filling, and the accommodating and knowledgeable waitress added to the experience. We visited on their second-year anniversary and received complimentary cava wine, a delightful surprise. While the dishes showcased their own unique personality, I was slightly disappointed as the gyoza and burgers shown in the images were not available. Although the concept is great, based on my experience, I wouldn't recommend it. However, individual taste preferences may differ, so others should give it a try and form their own opinion.

Came here for the Tuesday evening tasting menu and found the whole experience exceptional. £40pp actually seemed like really good value for money for eight courses plus pickles and olives. Each dish was varied and beautiful with really interested flavours you would never do at home, it did vegan food amazing justice! Atmosphere and service was lovely and didn’t feel pretentious. Plus some really interesting fermented wines to choose from and 241 on high quality cocktails. Loved the little environmental details, from eco friendly loo roll to the minor £1.23 optional charge on the bill to plant a tree! ❤️Highly recommend everything to do with this place.

Great menu with yummy vegan options. Short ribs and oyster mushroom burgers were inventive and tasty and you certainly don’t feel like you are missing out by choosing not to eat meat. Chilled atmosphere with good background music and friendly staff. Only criticism was it was on the higher side price wise - the plates are small so you order a few and it all adds up!

name: Empire Lounge Bar & Restaurant
address: 777 Old Kent Rd, London SE15 1NZ, UK

reviews.text:
It use to be a good place to visit but not anymore. The food was tasteless, the services was extremely poor. We waited for 60 mins for suya and when it arrived, it was very bad, no flavour.  The fish came after 90mins and the presentation was awful, served with 3 fried yams and 3 plantain.  The fish was dry and burnt. We ordered amala but we got pounded yam, it was awful
We have to cancelled the rest of our orders and went down the road to eat isi ewu, which cost less and far better.
No space it was packed
We will never go there again

Dreadful place. Avoid if u can but by the time we left it was packed. We waited 45 minutes for jollof rice , chicken and plaintain ( 3 plantain!!). It was ok. Very noisy and dreadful service. Had to ask for meal several times. My mum' s egusi took an hour. Music too loud. They must be doing something right as seemed popular. I thought it overpriced. Its more a night club serving food than a resto. Go for the experience but you cannot serve 3 slice of plantain to  Africans and expect a good review.

Oh I need to add. The staff and the manager were actually very pleasant. Its more a food organisation/ systems issue. Sort it out.

We ordered fish, TERRIBLE! The fish was soo hard we couldn't chew it. We call the attention of the manager , we gave him knife to help us cut "the so call cooked&fresh fish" 😕☹️😭😭Terrible customer service for me.
Never again.

Awful place, both service and food. Fish looking anorexic and small plantain for 25 pounds. Extortion to the highest.i wouldnt mind if it was good portion but terrible service a and terrible restaurant. If you have Enich money go there instead at least you will be full and know its money well spent.

I read some of the reviews and I'm bewildered that people have to complain about a spot I find very up to date with their services,i would say to the management of Empire lounge to keep it up,your services are 2nd to non,I will always patronise your spot,the catfish peppersoup was a banger and the seafood okro was out of this world,do not be deterred by the negative reviews cos you can't satisfy or please everyone,focus on getting better and better.
Please don't stop the music,the music is what I also enjoy,shout out to your amazing DJ.

name: Alhaji SUYA Peckham
address: 15 Peckham Park Rd, London SE15 6TR, UK

reviews.text: Woooow…. So my bus was due in 5 mins and I was hungry and needed something quickly to eat whilst on the bus so I popped in and was greeted by a nicely mannered lady. Now… I have been here before and had a Chicken suya and jellof and it was delicious!!! After a moment I ordered a chicken tozo shawarma wrap with plantain.. thank the lord I ordered with plantain lol I told the nice lady my bus was coming and it it’ll be  ready, she said yes and got to it. She wrapped it up just as my bus came and I was delighted and thanked her quickly. Once I sat down and bit in it this wrap I was like.. “WOOOOOOW… 😁THIS IS FIRE 🔥” and I bit again into some plantain and it was AMAZINGLY fiery and sweet!!! Definitely 10/10!!! I’d like to thank the lady who served me, it was delicious!!! Soooo flavourful and wrapped well!!! Thank you!!!! 🏆

I bought shawarma and the Suya rice meal and omggg it tasted so good I had to call my friends to tell them about it
I would definitely be coming back to order from them soon
Small shop, great customer service and great pricing. They increased the price a bit the last time I went, but still isn’t that bad. The food tastes amazing. Definitely worth it

I've tried several suya places in London (primarily South London) and this is by far the best. Unlike so many of the alternatives, the meat used, whether chicken, beef or lamb, is always great quality - not excessively fatty or chewy - and seasoned perfectly. Reminds me of warm nights in Lagos with amazing lip-tingling suya and a cold bottle of Naija Guinness. I drive nearly 2 hours to buy and it's well worth the journey.

Very quiet on a Friday night at 10pm. Mayb its the location or lack of eating out. Thw chicken suya was small and was pre made. Not fresh. Taste was good but tasted like it was made on an oven so not smoky. Same for the chicken suya. Compared to suya academy in Plumstead. Portion sizes were small. Beef suya same thing too. Pre made not fresh. Staff were amazing. Meatpie tasted like Jamaican pattie. If i wanted pattie. I would go to a jamaican store

I used to buy vegetarian pizzas from there often but the way the treat me and others during our recent order was so bad I refuse to buy from them any longer.  Summer time I would see the owner around and he'll always have a great manner about him and so did the staff (if he was around), so it's a shame their customer service has taking a turn for the worse. Food use to be amazing but ever since the chef left the the food became small and tasteless. Not a lot of meat on the pizza either. I don't know why the chef left but I want them to come back.
The fries where over cooked, cold and edible,  the donar kebab made me vomit after 30 mins of eating it, I would never go back there and if you have sense you will never eat anything from there.

address: Unit 5, 43-47 Glengall Rd, London SE15 6NF, UK

reviews.text: First experience is the worst so far! I would not recommend. I wanted to return an item which was burnt. I had emailed and called and I still did not receive my refund, 2 weeks later. Wasting money.
Best catering company ever. Fast delivery and best quality food. Go Go Al Desco

My partner recommended getting some food here as he’s been here many times and has enjoyed the food and thought it was good value for money. He hadn’t been here in a while and was surprised to see the price had increased to £10 per meal but the container sizes were like a lunch time special size. I was very underwhelmed with the size and surprised when he said he had just paid £30 for 3 small container and be told that sides such as salad coleslaw or plantain doesn’t come with the meal. I think adding some salad or coleslaw in a meal that costs £10 is very reasonable. I had rice and peas and the fried fish. The rice and peas was nice but the fish was very dry and tough and flavourless. Luckily my partner had asked for a separate EMPTY container but was mistakenly given a tub of sauce which they charged £1 for.But I was grateful for the sauce as this gave the meal flavour that was missing. We were really hungry at this point and still felt like we could have had more to eat. I think if prices are going to increase the size of the meal needs to match this.

I ordered the stew chicken and curry goat with rice and peas, and everything was delicious! The portions were generous, the flavours were authentic, and the food was cooked well. Friendly service and no more than a 10 minute wait. I’ll definitely be ordering again

Curry goat was tender ill give you that but in terms of taste it was lacking spice and seasoning well to my taste buds anyway and the  amount of goat meat was very minimal i mostly got fat and bones and i couldnt even get the marrow out of the amount of bones i had, i dont think i got 2 teaspoons of meat in that whole meal which is disappointing and the rice was ok and the staff could really be abit more talkative and didnt see one smile

Delicious. First time but not the last. I got the jerk pork and fried chicken with rice and peas plantain, and it was lovely but I would've liked extra gravy but that's personal preference, will be back, plus the young lady that served us was really friendly.

Honestly, I didn’t realise I was signing up for a biology lesson when I ordered a jerk chicken meal. £12 later and what did I get? Flesh. Not food — flesh. The chicken was so raw I half expected it to cluck. It had been sitting in a hot container for over an hour, and still looked like it needed CPR.

I declined the offer to reheat the rice (because shockingly, I like to avoid food poisoning where possible), and good thing too — clearly food safety isn’t a top priority. I even gave it a go in the microwave myself and guess what? Still raw. Still pink. Still not OK.

Tried to call the shop at least 9 or 10 times to sort it calmly — no answer. Not once. So here I am, sharing my experience with the internet instead.

To serve someone raw chicken and then be completely unreachable? That’s not just poor service — it’s a public health hazard with a side of cowardice. I’ve supported this place for years. Sadly, this is where it ends. Do better, vile

First visit. Love at first pint!

The landlord asked if I'd had the beer before. No. Gave me a sample. Liked it. Isn't that just great.

Well it's karaoke night. So much fun. I wish my wife was with me and I could stay all evening.

🚇 Nunhead
🍺 £5.50 Pravha

The Man of Kent is one of three pubs located around Nunhead Green just south of Peckham. The nearest station is Nunhead mainline, it’s a five minute walk to get here.

This former Truman’s pub was originally built in 1867. Much like many Truman’s pubs, it was rebuilt in the 1930’s as part of their “improved pub” directive to make pubs more attractive to women. On the exterior the is the Truman eagle and beautiful stained leaded windows.

This is a good size oldschool pub that two has two adjoining bars and a sort of snug at the back. The servery is centrally located and is simple and functional. The decor is traditional with some exposed brick walls, an open fire, traditional furniture, a Joanna plus a few Guinness and spirits mirrors dotted around the walls. At the back of the pub is a cosy beer garden.

The beer line was all keg and was full of familiar favourites. I decided on a pint of Pravha, my pint was excellent, price point was below average. There is no food menu here but there are popups from time to time. Currently @dudadiner is in residence serving up tasty Malaysian food.

We arrived around 1pm on a sunny Saturday lunchtime in July. The pub was fairly busy with loyal locals sat around the bar eyeing up the horses for the next race. The atmosphere was upbeat, the locals were ripping into each other which had us in stitches. The service was fantastic, we received a warm welcome from the Lady behind the ramp who was friendly, funny and courteous.

This pub has plenty to keep you entertained including, live sport, a variety of different live music acts, check their socials for what’s on.

@themanofkentse15 is a down to earth oldschool local with a warm and welcoming feel. I loved the architecture, most notably the original stained glass windows. The locals and staff are friendly, the beer is on point and reasonably priced. This is proper London boozer.

ℹ️ Info correct on visiting 27.07.24
Often busy in The Man of Kent. Cheap pints, good atmosphere, friendly staff.

Very friendly owners and staff. Great Guinness and reasonable prices. Feels like a proper community pub that is rare to find in London or anywhere else. Highly recommend stopping in for a pint if you’re in the area.
Best of guinness in south london , vin the landlord gave me history of nunhead , sandra landlady was so friendly and professional.
