reviews.text:
Staff very rude and dismissive - claim to not participate in any app promos even though their store is listed as a participating restaurant, but they don’t care… as if the discount is coming out of their own pockets or something.
Always give less salad and sauce than other Subway restaurants - I once got a salad and the box was half filled ?
If the store reopens, please hire new, better staff too!

A nice branch of Subway located inside the Asda superstore.
It is right by the bus stop so very convenient to grab some food.
The joint is nice and spacious as well with good social distancing.
Food is fresh and tasty.

I work in a nearby store so find myself in this subway quite regularly. I have had nothing but great experiences - fast, effective and great quality service as well as food. Kibria and Shohel (the store manager) are always so pleasant. Thank you guys :)

I had asked for a veggie delight, Only onions, sweetcorn and lettuce, the manager made up the sandwich and when i asked for extra onions as i only had 3 ingredients, he refused saying he cant, very rudely, even after explaining i only had 3 items, he stated i should choose more items, but i cant have more onions!!! absolutely ridiculous and crazy that i was a healthcare practitioner who was working in the car park at the time in a mobile unit, very disappointed with the service.

It’s almost as if the subway management doesn’t want to take this branch seriously. They need a serious revamp with their atmosphere and staff. Staff is simply not welcoming and half of the things aren’t available. Try asking them about some ingredients or a sandwich and you will get a standard answer of if you want it you can ask for it. I have visited this place thrice and not once I found a table clean. I seriously don’t understand how is that possible. At least convert it into a cloud kitchen or something. You will save up on rent as well

The food comes in small portion sizes and is actually tasteless. Really disappointed as always like to support local business. I could have cooked more flavoursome food - it’s clear they just don’t care. E.g. the jollof rice was pale and had no flavour. Do not waste your money.

Lovely ambience. Cool and cozy. Tasty food and pleasant staff. Nice place for a group of people to meet or have a private party  and enjoy Sierra Leonean cuisine. Hot chicken wings was very delicious for starter and fish was deep fried with pepper sauce took the fish to another level. If you liked to eat fish head, here is your chance for a finger liking experience.
The food is so good, the portions are large! The service is above and beyond. So grateful to have visited this restaurant instead of going elsewhere.  God bless the cook!
Nice relaxed restaurant. Had the fish with jollof rice it was great. Can't wait to go back again.

Really relaxing, cosy and friendly place. you feel 100% welcomed.  The only downfall is when they have private bookings you are turned away. Always better to call first.

I love it.

Wow is all i can say. We recently stopped using our local chinese shop after the quality of food declined and we were delivered RAW meat. My mum lives local to palace and told me to give it a try. It was absolutely unreal. All hot & cooked fresh as we waited in store. Loved every dish we ordered. Will definitely be our new restaurant, even if it means us driving 4 miles to collect it!

I usually get my chips and battered sausages from here. The food is always tasty and fresh, and the customer service is polite and welcoming. I would highly recommend coming here. Also a sidenote, they only accept cash.
After eating for the first time tonight 09/02/26 Avoid at all cost doesn’t even resemble Chinese food and taste, like nothing I’ve ever tasted before absolutely disgusting

haven't been into this restaurant in a number of years but today I thought I give it a try. hopefully I don't end up in A&e with food poisoning. it's one of the worst Chinese local restaurant hasn't changed at all. I think actually got worse. ordered pork fried rice Rice was clumpy very dry and soya sauce. as if they use the minimum Tash  no flavor. the rice look like they've took it out of the fridge. I should have never gone there I already wanted to give them a try but as usual waste of money and I hope I don't end up in hospital with food poisoning
Standard Chinese takeaway. Usual menu. Prices about £10 a head. Food was nice. Recommended.

Overall a very nice experience and was the first time here. The service was grand, the staff were super friendly, quick service and the food tasted delicious.

There were also specials to also choose from, not too much on the menu which I think is always a good thing, plenty of wine choices to complement the food.

Got there early evening on a thursday and then the restaurant was full, shows popularity and you could feel the place has been there a while and was a lovely evening.

Would go again and recommend it to anyone who enjoys Italian food.

Solid A*****

LDT x

Authentic little Italian which transports you straight to the Italian countryside!

Beautiful food, simple, honest and excellent cookery. 3 courses x 3 people and not one was flawed. Fantastic wine and lovely service by warm and professional staff.

Such a pleasure coming here..already booking for another trip for my birthday!

Gorgeous little gem of a restaurant! Classic family style Italian. Reasonably priced, tucked away in a corner of good old Peckham. Food is so fresh and tasty. Cosy atmosphere, great menu options. Excellent service from the lovely Alice.

The desserts were really good! As main dishes we had pasta, which was also tasty.
The Atmosphere has a cute Italian vibe and the service was friendly and attentive.

We had a lovely dinner at Il Giardino. My sis and I went at opening time to avoid the crowds. The waiter was friendly and the upstairs seating area was lovely. All of the courses were tasty and beautifully presented. We will definitely go back when possible.

name: Bay Dining Ltd
address: Unit 4 Canterbury Industrial Estate, 297 Ilderton Rd, London SE15 1NP, UK

reviews.text:
Everything was perfect and delicious!
Thank you to Rima and the girls for guiding us through the menu. The dishes were amazing and the ambience warm and welcoming. Slightly overpriced, but overall a lovely experience.

We had:
Starter:
Betel leaf wrap of ginger, peanut, shallot, coconut, galangal, kapi, palm sugar (gf, veo)
Main:
Steamed bamboo shoots and chicken in banana leaf, acacia, lemongrass, chilli, coconut cream (gf)
Stir-fry of venison, oyster sauce, sugar snap peas, cherry tomatoes, ginger (gf)
Stir-fry of kallets, chilli, garlic, yellow bean sauce (ve)
Dessert:
Vietnamese drip coffee with condensed milk
Yam doughnuts, fig jam, icing sugar (gf, ve)
Milo cheesecake, espresso caramel, rice biscuit, caramelised banana

We visited the Begging Bowl on  30 January 2026. We saw it on Instagram and thought we would try it.

It is a sharing menu. We ordered the pork curry, the fried Sea Bass, the stir fried Venison , hispy cabbage, Jasmine and sticky rice and a prawn salad and 3 non alcoholic cocktails.

The food came out as cooked, which was fine, however,  the portions were small and came in small bowls. For example,  there were 3 of us and the small portion of pork curry meant we got 1. 5 of a small square each  the prawn dish had 4 prawns!

The prawn salad, fried sea bass and pork curry were okay, but I would hardly call it authentic food.
It was very packed and our waiter was friendly and she provided good service.
The cons were that it was expensive for what we got the bill was £146, which is a lot for what we got. The non alcoholic cocktails were £8 each.
I am glad we tried it, but it is not a place I would revisit, the hostess showed us not interest , even when we were leaving and she was next ro the door, which she didn't open.!
I wish them well and I guess it is okay for a meal with friends,  but we will not be going back. £146 for 3 people, for small bowls in Peckham.
A fab Thai restaurant with some great vegan options. All the dishes were fresh and flavoursome, and great for sharing.   Not cheap but well worth a visit if you’re in the area.

We came with children for family lunch to experience new Thai flavours but instead we left hungry with £100 in our pocket… Very disappointed… my daughter ordered pomelo salad which was a main course and was around £13, we needed to look for pomelo in the salad… everything was very spicy and flavourless… We were expecting vibrant colours of vegetables and rich flavours like we have had experience in different places. Who is creating cold main dishes in winter? I have ordered prawns and they were cold and covered with bed of ginger shoots and other vegetables which I don’t know the name. Beautiful place and have so much potential if the food will be tasty.Very disappointing. We want be back for sure. By the way who is giving the name: “Begging bowl” for the restaurant. To be honest the name speaks for itself!

I adored The Begging Bowl 🍲. The vegan selection was incredible, and everyone enjoyed the plant based dishes 🥦. The wine was delicious 🍷. The server went to special effort to get some white that was chilled 🧊.

We had almost one of everything 🍽️. We ordered more of what we liked, and the dishes were brought to the table really quickly ⚡. Favourites were the pumpkin and celeriac curries 🥘. Another favourite was a layered potato appetiser that was incredible 🥔.

I would have loved pudding if I was not so full 🍮.

5/5 stars

Think this is a app kinda place. Very little English spoken - a child ended up taken my order (15 veggie dumplings) . Told to come back 15 mins later. Came back and told to wait another 15 mins. After a few rounds of farting and arguing I got the dumplings. They where OK. Nothing special.

Was a mad experience though . More entertaining than going to get frozen gyoza from the supermarket???

Authentic heart-warming Chinese comfort food. It's a homely take on jiaozi, you won't find this easily in the UK, I'm very happy to have discovered this place. I had the pan-fried pork dumplings and vegetable dumplings, both are very delicious and juicy.
Close for a while good dumpling good place. Close now
Best Chinese in Brixton, good price, good food! The lady is very friendly 🙏🏽
Amazing juicy pan-fried dumpling. They are succulent and moreish. Can't stop eating them. Paid £10 for 15 dumplings.

name: Patty Island
address: 40 Camberwell Church St, London SE5 8QZ, UK

reviews.text: Amazing experience, wonderful customer service (Didn't get his name, but banter and jokes from the moment I walked in) and Amazing food 🥰😍. Not from camberwell.. came for good food and GREAT food we GOT!!! Jerk rice, Jerk chicken, fried chicken, coleslaw and Patties 🤤🤤.  Thanks. Will be back. Hoping parking is better next time.
Amazing service and amazing food! Loved the sorrel juice as well. 💛💛

Not sure if it’s under new management or there’s a new chef but recently the food has been SLAPPING. Fresh patties, dark sweet plantain and the food looks fresh. Clearer pricing now too. Next time going to try the meats

The jerk chicken was very salty and horrible, the first chicken had no flavour. The festivals had no taste. The customer service was poor. If you know your food isn't great at least offer good customer service. It takes nothing smile!
I bought the patty deal for £7.50 along with 3 dinners for my family.  When I got home 🤢. Let's say they all going in the bin. Judge for yourself

name: Burger King
address: 46-52 Peckham High St, London SE15 5DP, UK

reviews.text: Flew in from Germany, this is the first I wanted to eat. Got a Whopper and it was lukewarm and the tomatoes were so hard they gave off a crunch. The sprite tasted like they used chlorine to clean the machine and didnt rinse it with water. The taste was very noticeable. Do not recommend, should have listened to the reviews.

The bathrooms are in a terrible state: dirty, smelly, and with no hygiene at all. There are two bathrooms available, and both are in awful condition. The staff does not provide any solution when the issue is mentioned. A very disappointing experience.🤮
No hairnet in sight. And this causes great threat to human consumption. Plus workers chewing gum whines talking to guests is inappropriate which counts as a poor customer experience and service

Only one toilet open, occupied by someone in there for 10 minutes. I asked staff to open another, this was ignored, one staff continued her dance routine.When I did get into the toilet, the floor was soaking wet, no soap etc. Avoid at all costs

Food was good as always is in burger king, service was fast, however the manager did try to charge me for a large meal, without asking if I wanted to go large. I understand it's a way to boost sales, especially considering how down everyone's sales are right now, but it's really not the best customer service to try to deceive your customers out of their money. He might find it easier to get more money out of us by simply saying "would you like anything else" or "would you like to go large"I personally know of a lot of people who would rather cancel their whole order and eat elsewhere than embarrass him by calling him out on his error... I hope he reads this and takes note, then perhaps his sales will increase in the right way...

name: Cafe Spice
address: Cafe Spice, 88 Rye Ln, London SE15 4RZ, UK

reviews.text: I was in Peckham with a friend and stumbled upon this restaurant. They have dine in and takeaway services. It’s not Nigerian owned but they sell mostly Nigerian foods. I got akara which was great, moi moi and some protein options. Prices were also very reasonable. They sell puff puff and some other Nigerian snacks. The service was also great and I got a discount on the moi moi which is always a bonus

The Most Disgusting Dining Experience Ever – Avoid at All Costs

I was absolutely horrified by how disgusting this place was. The smell was unbearable.

The utensils were reused without being cleaned, and the hygiene standards were appalling. The meat was rubbery and tasted like soap. The only thing that was remotely decent was the rice. To make matters worse, I found hair in my food, and it wasn’t properly covered, leaving it exposed to flies.

The lingering fish smell was so bad I had to go home and brush my teeth just to get rid of it. Even days later, I’m still haunted by how revolting this experience was. Unsurprisingly, I ended up with food poisoning.

This place urgently needs to be inspected by the local council’s Environmental Health Officers and the Food Standards Agency (FSA). It’s shocking that they’re allowed to continue operating in such appalling conditions. This was by far the worst dining experience I’ve ever had, and I wouldn’t wish it on anyone. Avoid this place at all costs – it’s truly disgusting.

Incredibly nice man served me, gave advice (when asked) on which accompaniments went best with the jollof. Perfectly spiced, huge piece of jerked chicken, stewed beef was really tender, generous portions of plantain and chili sauce, I was worried about the price but actually you get a huge portion and it lasts for 2 if not 3 meals. Definitely somewhere I'd recommend

A good place to pick up some authentic Nigerian food to takeaway. I like to get moi moi in the leaf here. 9/10 it’s a great consistency taste and the perfect amount of pepper. I’ve also tried some of their soups, meat on the stick and the jollof rice all of which have been good. My only gripe would be that the prices don’t remain consistent from one day to the next or by what is printed on the menu.

Came and collected take out today, staff were very friendly and helpful and the food did not disappoint, thoroughly enjoyed a mixed box of Jolloff rice, beef with plantain and oxtail. Highly recommend this place.

name: McDonald's
address: Retail Park, 518 Old Kent Rd, Malt St, London SE1 5BA, UK

reviews.text:
Popped in for a quick snack and coffee with my wife. Great spot. Nice music - not loud. Food is good and quick. We were helped by a girl called Israt who was super helpful and very friendly.

We had a great time. I would recommend this spot every time!! 😃😃🧡🖤

Extremely busy on my visit. The drive-thru queue was right back on to the main street. There were a few spaces available, I used one to park and ate inside. The restaurant was clean and spacious. Very quick service with food quality food, plenty of available seating too. The staff work hard and fast, well done to them. Highly recommend.

I mean, I love the new design of the restaurants and everything, but I just feel as though they’ve designed it this way, so that they have to interact with customers a lot less. I mean, how do you even pay in cash at this branch now? Who do you speak to? Like you don’t see anybody until it’s time to collect your food. The branch looks wonderful and cozy now, I really do love it, but where are the workers? They just hide behind the wall now. What’s worse? Is that they assume that everybody that comes up to the counter, is waiting to collect their food. Since when is everybody that’s coming into a till, just waiting to collect food? It totally escapes their mind that some people may want to order or just have a simple query. It’s not customer focused at all. It’s actually like you’re dealing with robots now that only understand customer service in this cashless way, where you don’t speak to people.

Don’t use the toilets! It is disgusting!

I wasn’t able to use the toilets at all — they were absolutely disgusting. There was something going on in there that was genuinely revolting, and I had to walk straight back out. And honestly, after seeing that, how are you meant to eat? It completely put me off my food and made me question the hygiene standards of the whole place.

I’m really disappointed because basic cleanliness shouldn’t be optional in any place serving customers. On top of that, the overall atmosphere felt negative and the service was slow. Staff seemed exhausted and disengaged, and the way we were treated made us feel more like a nuisance than paying customers.

This doesn’t feel like a one-off issue. It feels like a management problem. Cleanliness, basic standards, and respectful service should be the bare minimum.

Very disappointed with the drive-through customer service. The staff didn’t want to provide even a simple napkin with the food. Napkins are basic and essential when serving food  this should be common sense.

The way the customer was handled felt like they were doing a favor or charity, not providing a paid service. If napkins are not free, then please charge for them  customers don’t mind paying. But completely refusing and behaving carelessly is not acceptable.

We are paying with our own money and expect at least basic customer service and respect. The management seriously needs to train staff on how to handle drive-through customers properly.

address: 43 New Cross Rd, London SE14 5FP, UK

reviews.text: Delicious dimsum, better than any in Chinatown! The flavours are fresh and the fillings are generous. I recommend anything with prawns (hargow, siu mai, cheung fun) but everything is genuinely great.

The food is delicious with high-quality ingredients and beautiful presentation. The restaurant offers a spacious and elegant atmosphere, perfect for hosting parties or special events. Professional service and a great overall experience. Highly recommended!

I absolutely love dining at Hong Kong City! The food is incredible  especially the dim sum, which tastes so authentic and freshly made. Every dish is full of flavour and beautifully prepared. The service is excellent, and the staff are always so friendly and welcoming. You really feel looked after from the moment you walk in. It’s definitely one of my favourite places to enjoy proper Hong Kong-style cuisine. Highly recommend!

Amazing service! Beautifully Instagramable food👀 Me & my family decided to visit this place to treat ourselves and it did not disappoint. We got the weekend buffet and ate ourselves full. Unlike Chinatown buffets, this one includes table service so you just sit down and order as you please 😋 Really good looking food presentation wise but nothing stood out and atmosphere could be better. Our servers, Jewel and Yang (who surprisingly spoke Spanish!) were attentive and warm. Will come back ☝️☝️☝️

New management which shows significant improvement compared to last 20+ years I had in this restaurant. Visiting during the day with great taste Dim Sum. A few private parking space but free off street parking at night. Will definitely come again at night to try their main dishes and seafood.

Was driving pass and thought I’d pop in. Instantly amazed at the healthy menu available and decided I’ll have the smashed avocado with red onion and chilli flakes on toast. Amazing presentation. Food tasted as lovely as it looked. Staff were polite, friendly and welcoming. Oh and the music was very soothing.

We had to ask for our table to be cleaned twice as the 1st time wasn’t done properly.
All empty tables had crumbs. And at 2pm they only had cheese toasties left.
The place looks worn and looks like it needs some love and care.
The food was nice though.

Cosy cafe in East Dulwich/Peckham borders with outside seating as well. Food good; I particularly like their quiches & they also do lovely cakes. Friendly service. Very popular place & can get busy at peak times.  Thumbs up.

Wonderful location, disappointing food.
Minimal menu, which is fine, but get it right: quiche was insipid and not like any quiche I’ve had, just lacking, while the yellow, undercooked pastry had to be broken and bitten as cutting was too challenging. Grubby environment and lack lustre care about table clearing.
A café with potential and few damns given, based on our experience.
Lovely place under a big tree. Sitting in the sun, shade and enyoing breakfast could not be better. Very tasteful and with the best coffees and teas. Also great for mid day drinks and lunch.

name: Persepolis
address: 28-30 Peckham High St, London SE15 5DT, UK

reviews.text:
Got the festive 6 course menu including dessert and drink for £30, great value, was extremely extremely full (even though we didn't have lunch).

Not every dish was amazing, I found the green sauce at the end a bit bitter for example (though the rice it came with was very good). However I still give it 5 stars purely because I cannot stop thinking about the fried halloumi, it's just so so so good. And the hummus, falafel, and Cheetos? was so good!

They explained every dish as well, service was good, atmosphere on the rooftop terrace was good.
Warm atmosphere and quirky place. The ash and the cheesecake were highlights, unfortunately just a bit disappointed by the rice and bread !! Would be 5 stars otherwise as it was lovely.
Came here for a Birthday today, such a fantastic experience. The feasting menu option is so joyful and generous. Team incredibly welcoming. Thank you so much !
Had the tasting menu with my partner and it was absolutely incredible. Great value, we could barely finish it. Service was also amazing. It's obvious they're proud of their food and they should be 😊
Such a lovely place to chill out, chat and have yummy treats! There was 10 of us and we had some very impressive looking desert tasting platters and sat on the roof terrace which was so nice.

Serna was in customer service. She is also a student work hard in KFC.
She is very welcoming and helpful. Thanks for nice comment service.

staff had ignored us plenty of times, friends meals took over 30 minutes. won’t be back at this place, took forever, staff had ignored me and didn’t care. skipped meals and we had to wait 30 minutes! disgrace!

Don't forget they have to serve take out and drive through. The staff work hard for their cash! Expect chaos on the last week of Aug, Tuesday!!!
Very friendly staff, they smile and greet to me when I order. Many seating available and the food is good.

reviews.text: My favourite meal of the year so far. Peckham Bazaar delivers an incredible tour of the Balkans in one sitting, with grilled dishes and mezze that are full of flavour and beautifully balanced. We shared fluffy pitta with a dip, followed by chickpea croquettes, beetroot with whipped mizithra, grilled tiger prawns with Greek orzo, pumpkin and Parmesan manti, and a standout stuffed globe courgette. Every dish was spot on and clearly cooked with care. The atmosphere was warm and buzzy even on a Monday night, and seeing the chef grilling in the open kitchen adds to the experience. A true neighbourhood gem and a must visit in Peckham.

I booked Peckham bazaar for my 26th birthday lunch for 15 people and it was FLAWLESS. The food was incredible and so nice for sharing - no dish missed the spot (although the chicken souvlaki, flat breads and dips, courgette fritters were stand out!). Beyond this, the staff made the experience the most hospitable and lovely I could have ever dreamed of (special shout out to Tim who made my day so so special!). Honestly I rarely leave reviews but this was the best experience and I’m so grateful. Thank you!! Highly recommend to anyone looking for a birthday lunch spot with friends!

Peckham Bazaar is, without question, our favourite restaurant in London.

Tucked away just off Bellenden Road, it feels like one of those rare places that never tries too hard and yet gets everything exactly right. The food is exceptional, thoughtful, seasonal and quietly confident, with Balkan and Eastern Mediterranean influences that feel both comforting and exciting. Every dish is beautifully balanced, generous without being heavy, and clearly cooked with care and skill.

I absolutely love Peckham Bazaar - I have been a few times over the years and went yesterday for lunch with friends. The food was all excellent, great sized portions and the flavours made me feel like I was on holiday in Greece! Gorgeous restaurant ambience and great service. It was my first time sitting inside and it is quite small so definitely book in advance - there’s spill over onto the heated terrace but it was special sitting inside. They made space for our pram and they also allow dogs! 10/10 will be returning again and again

Food here was very nice, good quality and well cooked. Some very nice star dishes. I enjoyed visiting here, book in advance as availability isn't great on the day when I wanted to go. Had to get an earlier meal but that was a Friday night.

reviews.text:
I stop putting salt in my food a few months ago and actually stop eating Chinese during this time.
I decided to have a cheat meal from here and the amount of salt within my food was crazy. Ended up drinking so much water to take the taste of salt out of my mouth. Maybe it was a one off but I will not be going back here anytime soon
Unbeatable price/quality ratio. Super delicious food and generous portions. Dont expect 5-star service, be aware of what kind of place this is

Would give 0 if possible , preferred ribs in honey sauce and has absolutely no honey, ribs are stale and dry and rice smells off. On top of that I almost waited a bleeding hour for my food to come even though I live 5 mins away. Do not buy from here

Did a phone order lastnight for the children as I was away and our usual shop was closed.. we ordered sweet and soup chicken and boiled rice... The children complained and didn't eat the food protesting that it was very salty. Waste of money really. They didn't call and tell me until I came home so I couldn't call and let the shop know. I will today and see what will be there response

I strongly urge you to avoid this takeaway at all costs; it is unacceptable and should be reported to the Food Standards Agency immediately! The man taking orders was scratching his head, causing dandruff to fall onto his shirt, which he casually brushed off with his hands. Another employee was sneezing without bothering to cover his mouth. I left feeling nauseated and appalled by the lack of hygiene. They have put me off buying Chinese food for life!

For a bar, they make some STELLAR pizza and cake. Seriously, the food here is comparable to specialised pizza restaurants and bakeries. Drinks are made fast and efficiently with a relaxed atmosphere. Great hangout spot for friends. I recommend getting an English Garden as a drink here.

I agree with the "artsy" comments, and I am a bit undecided on whether the place is purposely like that or just neglected, but either way, it did the job. Prices are definitely not neglected, fyi, but not more expensive than any other pub in the area either. There are some food options which I did not get to try but those seem to be priced all right.
The outside area is a nice touch for those rare summer days when you actually can actually sit outside but at 22:00 you will be asked to move inside.

The Peckham Pelican — Art, Pizza, and Chill

Located near Camberwell College of Arts, The Peckham Pelican is known for its affordable menu, relaxed ambiance, and support for local artists. It’s a great spot for students, creatives, and anyone looking for a no-frills, welcoming place to hang out.

What to Expect

Pizza & bar snacks — simple, tasty, and budget-friendly

Wide drink selection — beers, wines, and casual cocktails

Outdoor seating — ideal for sunny afternoons

Art on the walls — rotating exhibitions from local artists

Digital payments accepted — including Visa, Mastercard, Amex

Great vibe inside, nice drinks and comfy seating
Didn’t get food but their food menu looked very nice. Great value prices for drinks and food.

The Peckham Pelican — Where Art, Eats, and Atmosphere Collide

Located near Camberwell College of Arts, The Peckham Pelican is a local favourite that blends pub culture with a creative twist. It’s known for its eclectic crowd, rotating art displays, and a menu that’s simple but satisfying.

Food & snacks:

Chorizo pizza — one of the most popular items, spicy and cheesy
Laksa — a surprising Southeast Asian touch
Chips & bar snacks — perfect with a pint
Cakes & bagels — ideal for daytime visits
Vegetarian-friendly options — clearly marked and well-liked

Drinks:

Cheap beers & cocktails — great value for London
Corona, wine, and spirits — casual and well-stocked
Coffee & soft drinks — for non-alcoholic moments

Atmosphere:

Artsy and relaxed — attracts students, creatives, and locals
Live performances & events — music, spoken word, and more
Outdoor seating — great for summer evenings
LGBTQ+ friendly — inclusive and welcoming
Free Wi-Fi — makes it a good spot for solo visits or remote work

Such a beautiful surprise,
You feel like you are outside London.
The community is very strong.
The selection of drinks are amazing and the food, ulala !

Big shout out to the team making this venue unique and so welcoming:
Jake and Jude!!!

Thank you for your first class service, we shall come back
I do hope you will get the right recognition!

We came for a lovely Sunday lunch a couple of weeks ago to celebrate our daughter's 30th birthday. She has had a very complicated medical condition since birth and we welcomed some of the local special frineds who have helped our family for her lifetime. We arrived early to dress the table; the staff could not have been more professional, engaged and downright lovely if they had tried! We were helped all afternoon by the fantastic duo of Jude and Rosa and the efficient and clever kitchen staff who we never saw, but who cooked up a storm and were very complimentary about the two birthday cakes we shared with them afterwards! The food was just fantastic; the lamb perfectly cooked; the veggie option was also excellent and plentiful; the yorkshire pudding and cauliflower cheese were fab too. Our first Sunday lunch there, but certainly won't be our last!
Had a lovely night out here.  Staff were great.  Had the Butternut squash dish. Plus Malbec.  Nice local vibe.  Live music tonight ( Thursday).  Recommended!

Love this local! Staff and management are great, super friendly. Great selection of beers and wines. £5 negronis are a weekly highlight. Food - big plates or small - is consistently delicious. Décor is charming. Real fire in the winter and Murphy’s stout on tap are big bonuses. Pictured is a New Year’s Day pie ‘n’ pint meal with pals - hit the spot given the sore heads.

Lovely local pub - fantastic food selection both during the week (bavette steak and chips were delicious and the portion was huge) and on the weekend (lamb roast on Sunday was absolutely perfect). Really good drink selection as well, and staff are friendly and efficient. Does get very busy but able to book ahead for food.

If I could give zero stars, I would. Serious intervention is needed here. Fast food is supposed to be quick  in and out but I honestly think a sit-down restaurant would be faster than this McDonald’s. I’ve never been to this location and received my food in under 15 minutes. Head office really needs to step in because if it’s not the slow service, it’s the rude customer service .

Waiting time is atrocious. Waited over 15 minutes before walking out. Tried to speak to the manager, just to query how long I would have to continue to wait. The response I got was, “I am busy”. Best part there was only myself and one other person waiting for our meals to be ready for collection. Never again.

I’m all for religious faith and all of that but to wear a Silver bracelet and to not wear gloves when touch people’s food in the kitchen is very disrespectful, there was this man i don’t want to assume but was indian and had his bracelet touching my burger, now that is very unacceptable, can staff please encourage others to be more professional and careful about people’s foods and what and what not to wear in the kitchen.

The waiting time is unacceptable. Did does not matter what you order you are waiting at least 15 minutes for your order.  They prioritise their Uber eats over there walking customers every single time. Don’t go here the customer service is poor and slow.  I have to ask for them to cancel my order and get a refund, without an apology.   Will not be returning.

TOOK TOO LONG 30 MINUTES FOR A CHEESEBURGER, FRIES, 4 NUGGETS AND A DRINK. they didn't give me a straw or the correct change, refused to give me my change, and gave my friend the entirely wrong drink. Don't come here please go to the one in Camberwell , it's so much better. THE  PECKHAM ONE IS HORRIBLE.

reviews.text: Sorry to crack this down! I felt that the KFC is understaffed or some problem, but the standard they are maintaining is really cool. Love its hygiene, the chicken breast piece was so large! Yum yum! Absolutely stunning in a filthiest possible way! 😍 Rude staffs running and only one person in the fronthouse who is serving!

Trash strewn. Bins overflowing. Not a hand wipe to be had. The food was fine, but the restaurant - horrifying. Staff members were more concerned about closing down the main seating section than cleaning the part customers would use.

Ordered a peppermint krushup and it was the worst drink I’ve had in my life. It’s so sour and tastes spoilt. I’ve ordered the same before in Twickenham and it was really tasty. I think their peppermint flavoring might have turn bad.

One of the male staff members cat called me and made me feel very uncomfortable, especially when we were some of the only customers in there and it was late. He continued even after other staff said to stop. Then a female member of staff asked us not to report it but a complaint has been formally made.

We ordered some delicious KFC chicken through the app, but the delivery took more than 80 minutes, and by the time it arrived, we had already lost our appetite. Some l items were also missing from the order. However, when we spoke with the store manager, Mimi, she was extremely polite, professional, and resolved our issue within minutes. Thank you, Mimi!

I called in advance to let them know that I had reserved two too good to go meals, I was very happy with what I received, the food was delicious, nicely spiced and plentyfull I would highly recommend this place, I. Travelled for twenty minutes to get to the shop and it was worth it. 😋😋👏

I got their Too Good To Go bag today. Absolutely amazing and well worth the money. I got so much from the bag! It's basically 3 meals worth, I'm full just from a little bit of their food. Their dishes are well spiced and very flavourful and I really enjoy the different textures that the various veggies give!
My food came with 2 bowls, a curry of a sort, poppadom and a bag of crisps as a thank you. So lovely and warming!

We ordered a too good to go! The food is a different flavor from what I’ve had before! One of the curries was sweet and coco-nutty! Tastes very fresh! The man at the counter was incredibly kind and friendly!!! They were very kind about my gluten intolerance!

Delicious indian takeaway.
Cooked properly, homemade curries, tasty and fresh. Huge range if dishes on menu. I love the lamb curries, so tender.
Only thing is wait is always around 1 hour and also portions are on smaller side.
Also some of the veg sides are a bit simple.

Just had a surprising vegetarian feast from here. The food is delicious, fresh and there are a few things on the menu that you don't find elsewhere. Definitely  a cut above the rest, especially if you're a vegetarian. Veg dhansak and courgette curry excellent 👌🏼

reviews.text: We rented the Garden room on Saturday night for a joint 30th birthday party and truly had the best time. The room is spacious, nicely decorated, with a private bar, some seating, and was attached to outdoor deck/smoking area. We used their aux and sound system which was easy and volume was great. There was also a DJ deck on offer. The bartenders, Jack and Katya, were AMAZING!! Best hosts we could’ve asked for. There were a few instances where people from downstairs tried to join the party but we asked them to leave. The outdoor deck/smoking area is shared with downstairs so that’s something to take into account but we had no problems with it. 10/10 recommend this space for parties/celebrations!

Perfect party venue! I had my 24th birthday party in the Garden Room upstairs for 40 people. The room was perfect size and could’ve fitted more. I was taken care of by Jack and Marco who were attentive, professional and lovely. Although it was in winter, the garden section had heating which enabled people to move in and out of the space. Cannot wait to book again! Can’t recommend enough ❤️

Place is perfect if you love paying premium for budget misery. Otherwise, avoid. Staff move slower than evolution & don't understand orders and then get sassy about it & alcohol is overpriced. They give you the cheapest rail spirits imaginable & ran out of most booze before midnight on NYE.
Ps: cloakroom guy’s spirit animal is 100% sloth.

Customer service is unmatched, these guys will make you feel like you’re at your friend’s party, Alfie and Ayesha have been amazing at making our night the one to remember! Definitely coming back and bringing more friends here 💕

good cocktails and surprisingly good food, with plenty of veggie options. we booked a table on the roof terrace at 18:00 on a Friday. the vibe was super chill (although the service was perhaps a bit too relaxed). would definitely go back.

name: The Greyhound
address: 109 Peckham High St, London SE15 5SE, UK

reviews.text: Natty can cook's roti appetiser with scotch bonnet butter was delicious. The roast looked very pretty and appealing. The lamb chops were nice and well seasoned. The turkey wing was ok but needed to marinate a little longer. The veg, plantain and Yorkshire puddings were nice and the gravy was thick and flavoursome. The pub is a bit too cosy and was very busy; I can see how Natty may have outgrown the venue. The service at the bar was a little slow but the rum punch was generous and served in a pint glass.

I’m going to say, Nattycancook at the greyhound pub offered the best dining experience I’ve had in a while (and I’ve been to very expensive restaurants in the past). The food and drinks were great (8/10) and the service and atmosphere were exceptional (10/10). We had such a brilliant time.

We ordered The Lux, which had 5 different meats on the board, fried plantain, rice and peas, mac and cheese balls, roast potatoes and tempura broccoli. Drinks, we each had a Tutti Fruity and that was perfect, I would taste the Wray and Nephew so I knew I wasn’t been scammed out of watered down alcohol as most places seem to do these days.

The lamb chops, lobster tail, roast potatoes and mac and cheese balls were our favourite things on the board. The rice and peas was nice but didn’t taste authentic in our opinion. We put that down to Natty’s creative flair (plus, every Caribbean has a grandma who they’d say has the best food anyway).

For dessert, we had the lemon cake and custard and the red velvet cheesecake. We loved the lemon cake - it was super light! The red velvet cheesecake, we did not like. It was unusual…I still ate it but I wouldn’t recommend.

I CANNOT WAIT for him to have an established restaurant of his own. I absolutely recommend. 1000/10.

Lovely staff, great affordable pint selection the greyhound is really a pillar of the community and with the addition of patio pizza this is going to be a really special place, that guy KNOWS his pizza.

The snap on the crust is unreal, I’m so happy we’re getting a greater variety of pizza in London, neopolitan has been done as good as its ever gonna get, time for some new blood!
Such a cosy pub, and Patio pizza is so delicious. By far my favourite pizza in London. So worth it !!!!

I and my partner had a random day..an afternoon pint in a random pub..and it didn't disappoint  ,sampled some new stouts ,wow..talked to staff..great afternoon.then went back in the evening..vibes were fantastic,met so many people,music was so cool.had a awesome time.a must pub to visit at weekends

reviews.text:
"Remove the peppers and try to eat it"

People here have an attitude. They messed up my order then told me to remove the toppings I didn't want and try to eat the pizza.
2 12" pizza only having 4-5 pepperoni per pizza is shabby. Not even a pepperoni per slice.
No sincerity in their apologies. No refund option was given but an option for the driver to collect them and bring new ones. Their attitude sucked and no compensation was offered. They seemed to hate the fact that I called in to tell them they messed up.

If you mess up, be sincerely apologetic and offer to resolve it not tell the customer to remove the ingredients they don't want and try to eat it. Offer compensation if needed keep a good reputation.

Seems by the reviews I am not the only one.

Lol " remove the peppers and try to eat it"

Good pizza for like takeaway late pizza BUT I ordered double pepperoni and got several slices without pepperoni which essentially makes it half a margherita and the guy was just plain not interested in hearing me out and also there was loads of rubbish about obviously from previous customers but clearly left for a while

I will say though that the pizza is really good, like for you know takeaway fast food pizza that you know isn't good for you but you want it anyways, it's top tier just wish they would have given me my extra toppings

First and last time ordering from this place, I'm a local garage who usually orders from elsewhere but thought I'd give the locals a try, biy was I disappointed. chicken was soggy, dough was uncooked, pizza was cold and delivery took over an hour. took picture too so I can leave a bad Google review too. Avoid them like a CV19 if you don't want to be disappointed.

I recently tried the pizza from Delta Express Pizza in Peckham, and it was truly delicious! The flavors were spot on, with a perfect balance of toppings and a crispy, flavorful crust. The customer service was excellent, making the whole experience even better. Without a doubt, this is the best pizza shop in the Peckham area. Highly recommended!
I ordered a 7 inch pizza normally from a nice guy today was a new guy and he was rude gave me wrong size and wasn’t bothered to put the pizza in the bag .

A wonderful experience on our first night in the Camberwell area. It was a Sunday night and we were the only people in the place, but the warmth of the host made it special experience. Food was amazing with large portions, freshly cooked and delicious. Our host chatted with us until other patrons arrived and served us complimentary liqueurs. What a lovely place. Would love to return.

Came here for a dinner date. The atmosphere and staff were incredible, I really enjoyed my time there even though it was a quiet Sunday evening.

I had the moussaka and my partner had the pastitsio. To be honest we both thought the food to be good not great HOWEVER we also ordered items that tend not to be made to order, and therefore it isn’t fair to judge the menu based on that. We will 100% be back to try some of the grilled meats and other offerings.
The tzatziki and warm bread was a delicious starter.

I’d recommend this restaurant to anyone who likes classic Greek food and ambiance. It’s perfect for larger groups too!

Nice atmosphere with seating inside and outside and windows that open fully to the outside seating area. It’s a nice vibe and the food was alright with prices not too bad. Some of the grilled meats we had were a little dry and the fries not seasoned. Service was good and staff friendly. I think there was new staff on the day we went there and that person was a little slow and lost but in general it was fine.
Really good food and friendly staff and nice relaxed atmosphere.  I will be going again and highly recommend others to try it out.

Just had a delicious meal here today with a friend. We got the sharing vegetarian meze, absolutely delicious and a great variety of dishes that were of superb quality. The second course of vegetarian moussaka was equally as good. For dessert the baklava was really fantastic.
Great service with very friendly attentive staff. I highly recommend a visit!

Place of legends - has been my go to Chinese takeaway for 4 years and I am UTTERLY HEARTBROKEN to be moving outside their delivery radius.
Always such quick delivery, quality is consistent each time I order. Hong Kong Garden, I'll miss you.

Had chicken fried rice
And salt and pepper spare ribs.both dish had no taste proper tasteless.waste of money.avoid this place.

I miss the other people who owned it. Food was better priced to how it is now. Been coming to this Chinese since for over 10 years now it's changed I rarely go there now 🙁 (left 2 years ago)

Food is over greasy everything in the bag felt all oily the pancake roll was flat with a pool of oil at the bottom. Sweet and sour balls was over done or just recooked as chicken was dry. So from when i last ordered they haven't improved they've gotton worse.
I go south feast kitchen less grease and more fresh. Their delivery service needs improving may cost abit more but worth it as its better quality.
And seeing the response to my last review and others if it is you writing these are bang out of order!!

It’s alright, not as amazing as the internet makes it sound. If I was in the area I would go here again but wouldn’t go out of my way. The prices are relatively good for Chinese food in London nowadays. One major critic is that the rice was quite fried rice was quite flavourless. With the bbq sauce it elevated the taste and they used too much chilli oil just to make it spicy.
